I spent the weekend pushing the new Siri and am happy to report it's leap forward.

But once you've used personal agents, you ask Siri to do things it can't.

$AAPL reports next Monday. The most important topic is the shifting AI goal posts. 

In June the conversations was around was when will the new Siri come out. 

Now it's what's their answer to Muse, Grok Bot and Dots.
